verses.text: For the music director. By David, the LORD's servant. David sang this to the LORD when the LORD rescued him from all his enemies and from Saul. He said, “I love you, LORD. You're my strength.”
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my rescuer. My God is the rock I run to for shelter, my shield, the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
I call on the LORD, who deserves praise, and he saves me from my enemies.
Death's ropes wrapped around me. Floods of lawlessness terrified me.
The ropes of Sheol closed in around me. Death's traps sprang on me.
In my distress I called on the LORD and cried to my God. From his temple he heard my voice. My cry reached his ears.
Then the earth shook hard. Even the foundations of the mountains trembled because he was angry.
Smoke rose from his nostrils. Fire poured from his mouth, devouring everything and setting coals ablaze.
He bent the heavens down and descended. Thick darkness was under his feet.
He rode a cherub and flew, soaring on the wings of the wind.
He hid himself in darkness, surrounded by a canopy of dark waters and thick storm clouds.
At the brightness before him, his thick clouds swept by with hailstones and burning coals.
The LORD thundered in the sky. The Most High raised his voice amid hailstones and burning coals.
He fired his arrows and scattered them. With huge lightning bolts he sent them running.
The channels of the waters came into view, and the world's foundations lay exposed when you rebuked them, LORD, at the blast from your nostrils.
He reached down from on high, took hold of me, and pulled me out of deep waters.
He rescued me from my powerful enemy and from those who hated me. They were too strong for me.
They came at me on the day everything fell apart, but the LORD held me up.
He led me out into wide-open space. He rescued me because he delighted in me.
The LORD rewarded me for doing what's right. He repaid me because my hands were clean.
I've stayed on the LORD's paths and haven't turned away from my God to do wrong.
I've kept all his rulings in front of me. I haven't pushed his instructions aside.
I've lived with integrity before him and kept myself from sin.
So the LORD rewarded me for doing what's right, because he saw that my hands were clean.
You show mercy to the merciful and deal with integrity toward people of integrity.
You show yourself pure to the pure, and you outmaneuver the crooked.
You save people who are suffering and bring down those who look at others with arrogance.
You light my lamp, LORD. My God lights up my darkness. 🕯️
With you I can charge through a troop. With my God I can clear a wall.
God's way is flawless. The LORD's word holds up under testing. He's a shield for everyone who runs to him for shelter.
Who is God besides the LORD? Who's a rock besides our God,
the God who gives me strength and makes my way sound?
He makes me sure-footed like a deer and sets me up on the heights.
He trains my hands for battle so my arms can bend a bronze bow.
You gave me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand holds me up. Your gentleness made me great.
You gave me room to stride, and my feet haven't slipped.
I'll chase down my enemies and catch them. I won't turn back until they're wiped out.
I'll strike them down so they can't get back up. They'll fall beneath my feet.
You gave me strength for battle and brought down those who rose against me.
You made my enemies turn and run from me so I could cut off those who hate me.
They cried for help, but nobody saved them. They even cried to the LORD, but he didn't answer.
I crushed them fine as dust in the wind. I threw them out like mud in the streets.
You rescued me from the people's conflicts and made me head of the nations. People I haven't even met will serve me.
The moment they hear of me, they'll obey. People from other lands will submit to me.
Their courage will fade, and they'll come trembling out of their strongholds.
The LORD lives! Praise my rock! Lift up the God who saves me, 🙌
the God who brings justice for me and brings peoples under my rule.
He rescues me from my enemies. You lift me above those who rise against me and save me from violent people.
That's why I'll thank you, LORD, among the nations and sing praises to your name.
He gives his king great victories and shows faithful love to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
